name: presence is permission
headline: *Presence* is permission
say: Here is the part that surprises people. There is no account, and no sign-up. Hypercomb runs in your browser, with a desktop app on the way, and your work is kept on your own device. Nothing leaves it until you decide. When you do share, your work goes to a host: a home for it on the open web. That can be your own machine, your own domain, or the host of a friend you trust. Presence is permission. Your work is where you are, and it leaves only when you share it. Once it is served, others can keep a copy.
